artworks.title: Saint Mark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in the clouds. The image shows several cherubic figures interacting with an older figure. They appear to float among swirling clouds. In the composition, the lines are delicate and fluid, capturing a sense of movement. A lion's head is depicted in the clouds in the lower section of the image.

artworks.title: The Flight of Cloelia
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure riding a horse through a wooded area. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like style with fine lines and cross-hatching. The foreground features a horse and vegetation surrounds the figures. The contrast between light and dark areas in the image highlights the detailed textures and gives a sense of depth.

artworks.title: The Banquet of Antony and Cleopatra
artworks.artist: Jean-Honoré Fragonard after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting multiple figures in a detailed scene. In the upper portion, a figure is seated on clouds. This person is viewed from the side, with a leg folded, shoulder-length hair, and facing the viewer. In the center, several people are gathered around a table in ornate clothing from a historical period. Some are seated, while others stand, engaging in a social gathering. In the foreground, a child-sized figure wearing a feathered cap crouches or kneels, with a small dog beside them. The background includes cloudy skies and architectural elements like columns. Overall, the scene conveys complexity and gathering.

artworks.title: Mucius Scaevola
artworks.artist: Jean-Honoré Fragonard after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 16.5 × 11.3 cm (6 1/2 × 4 7/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image features a soldier in traditional armor and a helmet standing in the foreground. The soldier faces three seated figures draped in flowing garments on an elevated platform. The figures appear to be engaged in a discussion or judgment scene. The background shows a grand architectural arch. The details are finely rendered with attention to textures of clothing and architecture.

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Jerome
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with two figures. One figure is a muscular, bearded man draped in cloth, being engaged with a winged figure, likely an angel. The background features swirling clouds and an additional figure holding an object in the top left. The drawing demonstrates a classical style with detailed lines and texture contrast.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 13 × 7.8 cm (5 1/8 × 3 1/16 in.), cut within platemark

artworks.title: The Disciples at the Tomb
artworks.description: The image shows four figures with their upper bodies depicted. One figure is in a sprawling position with arms spread and head turned to the left. The second figure has curly hair and is leaning on a stone surface with a hand on their chest. Another figure with a voluminous dress and head wrap leans down towards a seated person. The seated person looks up at the standing figure and wears loose draped clothing. The background has textured shading resembling clouds.

artworks.title: Saint Luke
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly bearded figure surrounded by cherubs holding books, seated on clouds. The central figure wears flowing robes and has a contemplative expression. The background consists of clouds, with fine line work and detailed rendering typical of classical etchings. Each cherub holds a book.

artworks.title: The Two Prophets
artworks.description: The illustration depicts two figures. The figure on the left has a long beard and wavy hair, shown in a conversational pose. The figure on the right leans forward, with shorter, curly hair, gazing intently. Both figures are draped in flowing robes. Between them is a large open book on the reclining figure's knee. The background has a stippled texture.

artworks.title: Angel Holding a Palm and a Crown
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.1 × 13.9 cm (3 9/16 × 5 1/2 in.), cut to platemar
artworks.description: The image shows an angelic figure with wings and two accompanying figures. The central figure is standing on a cloud with wings spread wide, one arm raised with a leafy branch. The figures below the angel are seated on either side, each holding similar leafy branches, gazing upwards towards the angel. The scene is composed of detailed line work, with soft shading suggesting the texture of the figures and their surroundings. The background is filled with a stippling effect to convey a sense of depth and atmosphere, characteristic of classic etching techniques.

artworks.title: The Circumcision
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.6 × 14 cm (3 3/4 × 5 1/2 in.); cut within platemark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial scene involving several figures gathered around a central point. The scene depicts a group surrounding a child with a radiant halo, who is lying on an altar-like structure. The individuals in the drawing appear to be participating in or observing a ritual, as suggested by the presence of ornate garments and ceremonial objects. The detailed linework captures the intricate clothing and facial expressions, suggesting an air of solemnity and reverence in the atmosphere. The figures are engaged in a coordinated action, possibly indicating a narrative or symbolic event. The composition is tightly framed, focusing on the interaction between the figures and the central radiant figure.

artworks.title: Periphery [Periferia]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: This is a monochrome print showcasing a landscape. In the distance, an industrial setting is depicted, featuring thin trees and industrial chimneys emitting smoke. The sky is lighter in contrast. The foreground shows various textures, with rough, slightly abstract forms suggesting terrain or fields. The color palette is limited to shades of grey and black, emphasizing the industrial atmosphere. Delicate linear etchings create detailed yet sketch-like textures throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy on a Round Temple Enclosed with an Ambulatory (verso)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural columns and structures. The drawing depicts grand architectural elements such as large columns with intricate capitals that suggest Corinthian or Ionic styles. These columns are part of a rotunda or an open hall with a high, curved ceiling. The lines are light and delicate, indicating it might be an initial concept or draft. The background shows some indication of walls and stairs. The paper has a worn appearance with scattered smudges and marks throughout.

artworks.title: The Tiber with Saint Peter's and the Castel S. Angelo (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and ink with graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with an urban landscape featuring architectural elements. The scene includes a river, a bridge, various buildings with domed and rounded shapes, boats on the water, and a sky with sketched clouds. The sketch is created using fine lines and limited colors, giving it a monochrome appearance.

artworks.title: On the Brandywine
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund and the Randi and Bob Fisher Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a winter landscape with a snow-covered riverbank. The view is from a slightly elevated angle, looking down at the riverbank covered in snow. The horizon is high in the image, with leafless trees blending into the sky. The river's surface is mostly frozen, with visible cracks. Rocks and patches of dry vegetation can be seen poking through the snow. Snow-covered trees line the riverbank as it curves into the distance. The color palette is subdued, with sepia tones highlighting the light and shadow on the snow-covered landscape.

artworks.title: Vegetable Market at Pontoise (Marché aux légumes á Pontoise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Earl Hyde, Jr.

artworks.title: The Little Goat (La capretta)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a goat resting on a sloped patch of grass. It is depicted with its head lowered and eyes seemingly closed. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a top-down perspective. The horizon is placed towards the upper edge of the image, where the sky and distant blurred trees meet. The trees and vegetation are rendered with a combination of delicate and dense brushstrokes. The goat is depicted with darker shading, standing out in the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray. In the distance, a cluster of trees can be seen fading into the backdrop.

artworks.title: Personification of Engraving (Allegoria dell'incisione)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing forward. The person's facial features are delicately drawn with soft lines, and their hair falls naturally around their face. They are draped in fabric over one shoulder and holding a long, thin object in their hand. The background is textured with light and shadow, and the image is monochromatic with a visible signature at the lower right corner of the paper's border.

artworks.title: A Young Woman with a Bow in Her Hair
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a woman's body. She is positioned in a side profile facing the left side of the image, with her head turned slightly towards the viewer. Her facial features are soft and her expression is neutral, with detailed eyes, a straight nose, and gently pursed lips. Her hair appears voluminous, styled in waves, and is adorned with a large, dark ribbon or bow at the back. She is dressed in clothing that features a high collar or scarf-like material around her neck, which contrasts with the darker fabric of the rest of her attire. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held by the subject. The background is a simple, textured surface.

artworks.title: Pescatore di Grado [A Fisherman of Grado]
artworks.medium: aquatint, soft-ground, and monotype wiping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man in a portrait from the shoulders up. He is facing slightly to the left and looking directly at the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes, a weathered complexion, and a prominent nose. His hair is light and unkempt, blending into a full beard. He wears a dark cap with a broad brim. The chiaroscuro technique highlights the depth of his facial features. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the man's face.

artworks.title: Pope Gregory the Great and Saint Vitale Interceding for the Souls in Purgatory
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting heavenly and earthly figures interacting in a dream-like scene. A group of angelic figures with wings emerge from swirling clouds, interacting with figures below. The bottom section shows a bearded man and another seated figure pointing towards the sky. Angelic beings guide or lift souls upwards, continuing the celestial theme. The background includes clouds, a desolate landscape with a tower, and sparse trees. The artwork uses swirling lines for the clouds and detailed textures for the figures' clothing and features, conveying movement in the composition.

artworks.title: Nine Figures around a Herm of Pan
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with mythological elements. It features several figures situated in a natural outdoor setting. The figures are arranged in a harmonious composition, engaged in various activities. The landscape behind them includes trees, plants, and clouds, suggesting a serene countryside. The style of the drawing embodies elegance and balance, with meticulous attention to detail in the human forms and natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Six Nymphs and Two Cupids in a Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karin Wachtel in memory of her husband, Cesare Morini
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures with a towering structure and a tree in the background. The scene depicts several human forms, some reclining, in a pastoral setting that includes a large cylindrical tower on the left and a tall tree to the right. A winged cherub-like figure interacts with the group. The setting blends natural and architectural elements. The shading and line work are detailed, employing cross-hatching techniques. The background includes an expansive landscape view.
